description: This file defines utility methods for mapping SMS campaign status codes to EnumOptionData objects, encapsulating different campaign statuses such as INVALID, PENDING, ACTIVE, and CLOSED.

classes.name: SmsCampaignStatusEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to map campaign status enums to EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: status(Integer statusId)
methods.description: Converts an integer status ID to an EnumOptionData representing the campaign status.

methods.name: status(SmsCampaignStatus status)
methods.description: Maps an SmsCampaignStatus enum value to its corresponding EnumOptionData representation.
